summary.description: 2-4 sentences for the analyst. No amounts and no counts in this text; put amounts only in findings[].amounts_usd.

pattern_type.description: Typology the evidence most resembles; NONE_EVIDENT if none is supported by the evidence.

pattern_rationale.description: Why this typology, referring to structure (who sends to whom, timing). No amounts.

findings.description: Each claim with the transactions that support it.

statement.description: One factual claim. No amounts or counts in text.

tx_ids.description: Transaction IDs from the evidence that support the statement.

accounts.description: Account keys from the evidence involved in the statement.

amounts_usd.description: USD amounts of cited transactions, exactly as in the evidence.

open_questions.description: What the analyst should check that the evidence cannot answer.

evidence_limitations.description: E.g. evidence truncated, window limited to 72h before the alert, accounts at other banks not visible.
